title: Brazilian independence (Cry of Ipiranga)
summary: On 7 September 1822, on the banks of the Ipiranga River near São Paulo, Prince Regent Pedro proclaimed Brazil's independence from Portugal after a letter ordered him to return and submit to the king and the Courts of Lisbon. Portugal recognised independence in 1825 after mediation by England, and Brazil paid Portugal two million pounds sterling in compensation, with help from England.
